text:
Ishaan: FYI ran into a support ticket where the customer had three different env vars in their repo (RW_TOKEN, REDWOOD_API_KEY, REDWOOD_KEY). They copied examples and CI started failing after rotation.
Leah: argh. where were those examples?
Ishaan: quick grep: examples/sdk-node/README.md uses RW_TOKEN, docs/quickstart shows REDWOOD_KEY, and infra/docker/Dockerfile expects REDWOOD_API_KEY.
Marco: OK we need a clear canonical and aliases map. Proposal: canonical REDWOOD_API_KEY, support REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE for mounted secrets, and accept legacy aliases (RW_TOKEN, REDWOOD_KEY) but emit a one-line migration hint.
Leah: +1. Also recommend REDWOOD_ORG and REDWOOD_PROJECT for scoping (short names).
Ishaan: big UX gap: different SDKs surface auth errors differently. Node returns a generic Error on 401, Python raises AuthException with different message shape, Go returns status code only. That breaks caller retry logic.
Marco: SDK parity plan: unify an AuthError type across SDKs with properties: message, code (401/403/etc), retryable (boolean). Normalize 401 -> retryable:false, 429 -> retryable:true. We'll add tokenProvider hook to all SDKs so callers can implement refresh.
Leah: CLI changes: `rw auth login --format=json` should output machine JSON {"token":"...","expiry":"...","source":"cli"} and also show shell snippets for bash/pwsh/fish. Add explicit warning: "Do not commit tokens" and a short note about expiry.
cli-bot: note: current CLI prints a single `export` line only. Issue filed: https://github.com/redwood-inference/cli/issues/123
Marco: operational detail: when both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE exist, prefer file and log debug. In CI mode (REDWOOD_CI=true) treat it as an error to prevent ambiguity.
Leah: add runtime env-normalizer in SDKs: reads canonical and aliases, returns normalized object {keySource: "env|file|credentials_file", token: "...", warnings: [...]}. Print one-line migration hint unless REDWOOD_SILENCE_ENV_WARN=true.
Ishaan: rotation flow: recommend ephemeral CLI tokens by default (15m) and service principals for CI. Add REDWOOD_CREDENTIALS_ENDPOINT for org-managed refresh. CLI should emit expiry timestamp so orchestration can refresh before expiry.
Marco: go SDK gap: tokenProvider and normalized AuthError missing. I'll take parity issue and add tests that simulate rotation and 401->refresh flow.
Leah: docs action: update all sample READMEs to canonical env names, add a migration guide mapping legacy vars to canonical, and show examples for Bash/PowerShell/fish. Include snippet for safely using REDWOOD_API_KEY_FILE in GitHub Actions.
security-bot: scheduled rotation notice: org "alpha-partner" rotating keys 2026-09-10T02:00:00Z. Contact security if you need exceptions.
Ishaan: action items: I'll open PRs to swap env names in samples and add a grep script to detect legacy vars.
Marco: I'll file SDK parity PRs for Go + Rust and implement AuthError + tokenProvider.
Leah: I'll update quickstart, CLI docs, and draft the env-normalizer spec.
Ishaan: one small UX ask: when an SDK detects legacy vars, include a short one-line link: "See https://rwd.co/migrate-keys" so support can point customers there easily.
Leah: good idea. Also add an automated lint in docs CI that fails if examples emit plaintext tokens or use legacy var names.
Marco: sounds good. tagging @devex and @sdk-maintainers. We'll post PR links in this thread as they land. :thumbsup:
